description: Table Analyzer Artificial Intelligence is a Power BI visual that uses Artificial Intelligence to analyze table data and identify potential issues automatically. Users can drag and drop columns from their dataset, define what they want to analyze, and receive intelligent insights such as errors, anomalies, unusual values, and possible data inconsistencies. The visual is designed to help analysts quickly validate data quality and discover hidden patterns without complex queries or manual checks. Users can also write custom analysis requests, allowing Artificial Intelligence to evaluate the data based on specific conditions or validation rules. Key features include: • Artificial Intelligence powered table analysis • Detection of anomalies and unusual patterns • Identification of potential data errors • Custom analysis prompts defined by the user • Support for user-provided AI APIs such as OpenAI or Gemini • Configurable analysis refresh options • Fast insights directly inside Power BI dashboards This tool helps analysts and organizations improve data quality, detect problems early, and gain deeper insights from their datasets.
